summary: Implemented Console.set_window_title and supporting changes. Edited rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16, widened ControlCode union), rich/control.py (format entry and Control.title classmethod), rich/console.py (set_window_title gated on is_terminal), rich/_windows_renderer.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title once per control), and CHANGELOG.md (Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200). Added tests in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run or committed, so mypy, Black, and the test suite are unverified.
